description: The 2018 National Seismic Hazard Assessment (NSHA) - Derived Geo-spatial Product is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. As part of the 2018 National Seismic Hazard Assessment (NSHA), we compiled the geographic information system (GIS) dataset to enable end-users to view and interrogate the NSHA18 outputs on a spatially enabled platform. It is intended to ensure the NSHA18 outputs are openly available, discoverable and accessible to both internal and external users. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are EARTH SCIENCES, Earthquake Engineering, Natural Hazards, Published_External. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
